floorPlans.label: Aldar The Arthouse brochure and layouts
floorPlans.introduction: Compare one- to three-bedroom apartment layouts and the five-bedroom Sky Villa. The Sky Villa sheet shows its lower and upper levels together.
floorPlans.note: Confirm the signed drawing and area for the selected unit. The brochure includes building floorplates in addition to the residence layouts.

review.images: Eight original Arthouse brochure renders show the buildings, district setting, apartment living room and bedroom, and lounge. Generic Cultural District and lifestyle imagery was excluded.
review.location: The Madena visual outlines all three Arthouse buildings on the same original district aerial seen in Aldar’s brochure on page 55. It is labelled as an illustration. Aldar confirms the Saadiyat Grove and Guggenheim context. Madena’s travel estimates are kept as their own source set.
review.floorPlans: Reviewed the 13 residence sheets on physical pages 42–54 of the official PDF. The public Madena-hosted PDF repeats the same drawings. The published portal size ranges and individual listings do not establish an exact whole-unit area for each representative sheet.

unavailable: Signed plan-specific total areas and building entrance coordinates.
